chunks: And (Noah) said: "Embark in it. In the name of God is its course and its mooring. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful."
ai.seo_question: What did Noah say to his people when they boarded the Ark?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from divine command to human action, where Noah (AS) invites the believers to board the Ark while attributing its navigation and anchoring solely to Allah, emphasizing Tawhid in both movement and rest. The declaration 'Inna Rabbi la-Ghafurun Raheem' serves as a theological anchor, reminding the faithful that salvation is contingent upon God's mercy even amidst the trial of the flood. This moment marks the culmination of Noah's da'wah, distinguishing the saved from the doomed through their acceptance of divine guidance.
